harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «ن» is a particle with no grammatical position; «والقلم» is the thing sworn by, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb «أقسم» (I swear); «ما» is a nominal relative conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «القلم», i.e.: and what they inscribe.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause (ما أنت بمجنون) is the answer to the oath; «ما» is negative, acting like ليس, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in its khabar (predicate), which is «مجنون»; the preposition phrase «بنعمة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «مجنون», the implied form being: you are not mad, being clothed in a blessing.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «وإن لك لأجرا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما أنت بمجنون»; the lām is for emphasis; «غير» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «فستبصر» is resumptive; the verb here is suspended from governing by the interrogative after it.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «بأييكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun; the bāʾ has the meaning of (في), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «المفتون», i.e.: in which group of you is the one afflicted; the clause «بأييكم المفتون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of seeing, suspended by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «هو أعلم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «بمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم»; the second clause «وهو أعلم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first; the preposition phrase «بالمهتدين» is attached to «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «ودُّوا» is parenthetical; «لو» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «فيدهنون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «تدهن».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «ولا تُطع» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لا تطع» in verse (8).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «همَّاز» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {حَلافٍ}, and likewise «مشَّاء»; the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشَّاء».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «منَّاع» is a naʿt (adjective) of {حَلافٍ}; «للخير»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, and «الخير» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «منَّاع»; «معتد» is another naʿt of {حَلافٍ}, and likewise «أثيم».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن كان» is genitive by an implied (muqaddar) lām attached to (mutaʿalliq) the preceding verb of prohibition, i.e.: do not obey one whose attributes are these, because he was wealthy and possessed of sons.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The conditional clause is a second khabar (predicate) of {كَانَ}; «أساطير» is the khabar of an implied (muqaddar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they are legends (هي أساطير); and the clause «تتلى» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e.: We tried them with a trial like Our trial of the owners of the garden; «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقسموا»; the clause «ليصرمنَّها» is the answer to the oath; «مصبحين» is from the complete (tāmm) «أصبح», and it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ليصرمنَّها», i.e.: entering upon the morning; the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was omitted because of a succession of identical letters; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: (ولا يستثنون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فطاف» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طائف»; the clause «وهم نائمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «فأصبحت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «طاف».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «فتنادوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أصبحت»; «مصبحين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explanatory; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «فانطلقوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «تنادَوا», and the clause «وهم يتخافتون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and «مسكين» is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause «غدوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the fāʿil (agent) of {يَتَخَافَتُونَ}; it is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb with its noun and its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادرين».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; the conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قالوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: (بل نحن محرومون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «سبحان» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause «إنَّا كنَّا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «فأقبل» is resumptive, and the clause «يتلاومون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «بعضهم».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; «خيرا» is a second object; the preposition phrase «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا»; the clause «إنَّا راغبون» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase is attached to «راغبون».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: (كذلك العذاب) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «العذاب»; the clause «ولَعذاب الآخرة أكبر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: they would have obeyed us (أطاعونا).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: (أفنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and the kāf is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «تحكمون» is a badal (substitute) from the clause «ما لكم».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); the clause «تدرسون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب»; the preposition phrase «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدرسون».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The preposition phrase «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; the lām is for emphasis; «ما» is a relative noun, the noun of «إن»; the clause «إن لكم فيه لما تخيرون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of {تَدْرُسُونَ}, i.e.: you study in it that you have …; when the lām entered, the hamza took kasra.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); the preposition phrase «علينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أيمان»; the preposition phrase «إلى يوم» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أيمان» is attached; the lām in «لما» is for emphasis; the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to the khabar of «إن», whose noun is «ما»; and the clause «إن لكم لما تحكمون» is the answer to the oath contained in his words «أيمان».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «أيهم» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «زعيم» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «بذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زعيم»; the clause (أيهم زعيم) is the second object of the asking, suspended by the interrogative; «سأل» is suspended because it is a means to knowledge.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); the clause «فليأتوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لهم شركاء»; the conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) his words {فَلْيَأْتُوا}; the clause «يكشف» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «فلا يستطيعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يُدْعون».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «خاشعة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «يُدْعَوْن»; «أبصارهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «خاشعة»; the clause «ترهقهم» is a ḥāl from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in «يُدْعَون»; the clause «وقد كانوا» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «ترهقهم»; the clause «وهم سالمون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يدعون».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «فَذَرْني» is resumptive; the relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ in «ذرني»; the clause «سنستدرجهم» is resumptive; and the clause «لا يعلمون» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «وأملي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ}, and the clause «إن كيدي متين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «أم» is disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa); the clause «فهم مثقلون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «تسألهم»; the preposition phrase «مِنْ مغرم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مثقلون».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «فهم يكتبون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «عندهم الغيب».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «فاصبر» is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «صاحب الحوت»; the clause «وهو مكظوم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the pronoun in «نادى».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of impossibility-upon-impossibility [i.e. "were it not for"]; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing); the preposition phrase «من ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمة»; the clause «وهو مذموم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the pronoun in «نبذ».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فاجتباه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding conditional clause; the preposition phrase «من الصالحين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «وإن يكاد» is resumptive; «إنْ» is lightened and inoperative (muhmala), and the lām after it is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the conditional clause is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: they almost made you slip; the clause «ويقولون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يزلقونك».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وما هو إلا ذكر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition phrase «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكر».
